notes: This LER (338-2022-001-01) is a supplement whose narrative body consists almost entirely of corrective actions and a reference to a similar prior 1996 event at the same plant; the current event's own root-cause narrative (relay mechanically bound causing 1-SD-MOV cycling, N-36 IR NIS voltage adjustments) is described only via corrective-action text, not a full causal narrative. Block-13 cause code X / category Other and system AA / component CBD / manufacturer W120 are taken as authoritative for the CURRENT event, and the 1996 similar-event narrative (I/O amplifier card failure) is modeled as the causal chain per the detailed narrative text, consistent with rule 4 (official code governs category) while proximate_text quotes the narrative's actual cause statement. The referenced 1996 LER report number was not stated explicitly in the text (only the date and plant/unit), so a placeholder key '1-1996-XXX' is used per best available identification; ideally the exact LER number would be substituted if found in the source docket, but rule 9 requires copying the report's stated number, which was not given verbatim here.
